subject.title: Inject sibling agent list into session system prompt

question: Should sibling-agent roster metadata be exposed to model-visible context through an always-on prompt injection, through an explicit gated `agents_list`/discovery result, or not exposed by core yet?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested data includes configured agent identities, role/theme text, and agent-to-agent permission topology, so automation should not choose the exposure boundary.

options.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
options.body: Extend `agents_list` or a similar authorized discovery tool with a minimal allowed roster after maintainer-approved redaction and A2A policy semantics.

options.title: Inject Prompt Summary
options.body: Add an always-present prompt roster, accepting prompt-cache churn and broader model-visible topology exposure.

options.title: Defer Core Exposure
options.body: Keep this out of core until a broader multi-agent roster/security design is approved.

recommendation.title: Prefer Gated Tool Discovery
recommendation.body: Extend `agents_list` or a similar authorized discovery tool with a minimal allowed roster after maintainer-approved redaction and A2A policy semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: The `agents_list` history is the strongest owner signal for the discovery boundary that would likely absorb this request.
